description: Publish a product model on eBay as ONE live listing with variations: saves it first exactly like save_ebay_variation_listing (so eBay gets the articles as they are now), then publishes the whole group — a real listing buyers can purchase. Returns status: blocked (with issues — reason, message, skus — and nothing written), saved (a draft on eBay) or published, plus marketplaceId, listingId, variationCount, failed (variations eBay refused, by sku — nothing is published while any) and removedSkus (articles that left the listing). Needs listing creation armed on the eBay connection, and is refused until the workspace owner switches on AI publishing. Confirm with the user before calling. The result echoes the workspace.

marketplaceId.description: eBay marketplace id (EBAY_IT, EBAY_DE…) for a FIRST save, when the connection sells on several. A saved listing keeps its marketplace; omit it then.

model.description: The product model: its code — the productGroupId get_product and search_products return for every article of it — or its id. Its active articles on the eBay channel become the listing's variations.

name: publish_ebay_variation_listing
title: Publish a model's eBay variation listing
